images.name: 滑跟屈膝
sources: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/train/065_T-LOW-002_滑跟屈膝.png
images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Single photorealistic rehabilitation photograph, one pose only. Images 1–3 are IDENTITY and STYLE references: lock the same adult East Asian woman, exact face, natural body proportions, black ponytail, white short-sleeved T-shirt, dark gray trousers, soft studio light and pale gray-blue backdrop. Image 4 is the EDIT TARGET and camera/scene anchor for the heel-slide exercise. Preserve the woman's head and neck on the same low gray head cushion, supine torso, pelvis, resting hands, other leg, the long gray mat, camera viewpoint, framing, floor line, person scale and lighting. Change ONLY the near/test leg from bent to the STARTING position: straighten it comfortably alongside the other leg with both knees almost straight, the test heel resting down on the small thin folded gray sliding cloth. Move that SAME small cloth together with the heel away from her buttocks to beneath the EXTENDED test heel; no towel remains under the knee. The cloth is under the heel and clearly touching the mat. Both complete feet and toes, hip, knee and heel visible. The near leg remains separate and anatomically clear from the other leg. Ankles and toes relaxed naturally. No raised straight leg, no knee bending, no foot floating, no extra props, no straps, no weights. Keep the full original image canvas and crop; no text, arrows, numbers, watermark or panels. Intended as 065 T-LOW-002 step01.

qa.observation: 已实际查看最终PNG，仰卧测试近侧腿舒适伸展，脚跟接触灰滑布，头垫、肩背骨盆落垫、手位和机位与原s02对应。双腿长度及膝踝连接自然，完整手脚可見，未出现抬腿或悬跟；独立审查通过。
limitations: 滑布褶边与s02略有生成差异，不影响接触辨认。

images.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create a single photorealistic pose edit. Images1–3 are IDENTITY and STYLE references locking the same adult East Asian woman, exact face and black ponytail, white short-sleeved T-shirt, dark charcoal trousers, pale gray-blue studio backdrop, soft light and normal human proportions. Image4 is the EDIT TARGET for seated knee extension. Preserve its right-facing side camera, entire canvas and crop, person size, seated torso perfectly upright, head neutral, pelvis, thighs supported horizontally by the stable gray chair seat, both hands resting naturally on thighs, chair appearance and floor contacts. Change ONLY the near/test lower leg: lower it from the extended forward endpoint to the PREPARATION pose, bending the test knee naturally to about a right angle so that the shin hangs down freely from the seat edge, beside the other shin. Test thigh stays in complete contact with the seat, hip unchanged. Both bare feet complete and visible, placed naturally at or lightly touching the floor with test leg free to move; test knee and shin clearly separated from the chair front leg, with no chair bar or obstacle blocking the shin's forward path. The other leg stays in its original resting position. Natural limb lengths, continuous knee and ankle anatomy, relaxed toes. No ankle weights, elastic bands, dumbbells or extra props. No backward leaning, no thigh lifting, no dangling disconnected feet. Single photographed starting pose only, no text, arrows, numbers, watermark or panels. Intended as 066 T-LOW-003 step01.
